prompt: Make a one-page site for a fictional cafe called Saturday Coffee. Use only these facts: 123 Satoshi Way, Asunción, Paraguay. Open Tuesday through Saturday, 08:00 to 17:00. review: Meetup time is not silently changed to match cafe hours.
Menu and opening hours are editable.
Exactly three intentional empty photo spaces, with useful descriptions.
Contact action works as a mailto link, not an inert form.

review: All reader-facing navigation and section labels are Slovak.

prompt: Build a restrained one-page website for the fictional Saturday Repair Club. We meet Saturdays from 10:00 to 16:00 behind the old station. Bring a broken household object. Volunteers help you diagnose it; a repair is not guaranteed. Entry is free. Email repairs@example.com. Include an introduction, practical details and a photo space. Warm cream paper, dark green text, system fonts. Do not invent success statistics or testimonials.
refinements: Keep the design and all facts. Put practical details before the introduction, and add that children must be accompanied by an adult.
Keep that order and the new rule about children. Make the introduction half as long. Keep the photo space and contact link.
review: Each revision changes the selected proposed version rather than starting again.
The final page retains the child-accompaniment rule introduced in revision two.
Existing facts and the photo space survive all three requests.

prompt: Create a practical static beginner's bicycle maintenance guide with twelve clearly separated sections: inspection, tyre pressure, punctures, wheel removal, chain cleaning, lubrication, brakes, gears, saddle adjustment, lights, storage and when to visit a mechanic. Use concise general guidance, no invented brand specifications or exact torque values. Include an on-page contents list whose links work, a short tool checklist, and a clear reminder to use the bicycle manufacturer's specifications. Readable at 390px with no horizontal scrolling. Leave two spaces for diagrams supplied by the owner; do not invent diagram URLs. Make this one complete HTML page, with all twelve sections finished.
review: All twelve requested sections are complete, including the last one.
Contents links resolve to actual section IDs.
No arbitrary torque specifications or external diagram URLs are invented.
